title: Manuscript compile (chapter-joined Markdown)
description:
`littera export markdown` already writes the whole work as one file, but it is a labeled dump (Document: prefixes, [lang] tags). Add an explicit compile mode that joins documents as chapters and sections as headings, with block prose and mention labels only — a manuscript, not a debug dump.

Reuse io.py. Do not invent a second export format family.
design: `littera export markdown --compile` (and TUI/desktop wrappers) calls the same exporter with compile=True: no Document: prefix, no [lang] tags, mentions reduced to visible labels, documents as ##, sections as ###, blocks as paragraphs.
acceptance_criteria:
- Default markdown export is unchanged (labeled dump)
- --compile produces one chapter-joined file for the whole work
- CLI, TUI, and desktop use the same io.py function
close_reason: export markdown --compile joins chapters without Document:/[lang]; TUI C and desktop palette use the same io.py function. Default labeled dump unchanged.

title: Word count (CLI + TUI + desktop)
description:
Count words in block source_text, scoped to work / document / section.

CLI is truth: `littera status` shows work totals; `littera wc` accepts --document / --section selectors. Strip mention markup `{@Label|entity:uuid}` to the visible label before counting. TUI shows the current-scope count in chrome. Desktop shows the count from the same function via the sidecar.

Not autosave. Not a live editor ticker of unsaved buffer text unless it is clearly labeled as draft vs saved.
design: Shared count in Python (not SQL) so mention-stripping stays consistent. Whitespace-separated tokens after stripping `{@Label|entity:uuid}`, light markdown markers, and link syntax. Reuse existing document/section selectors.
acceptance_criteria:
- `littera wc` and `littera status` report the same work-level count
- Document and section scopes work via existing selectors
- `{@Ada|entity:uuid}` counts as one word (Ada)
- TUI and desktop display the count; no mocked PG
close_reason: CLI status + wc (scoped --document/--section), TUI word-count bar, desktop /api/status + /api/wc + sidebar. Mentions {@Label|entity:uuid} count as the label. Real PG tests in test_words.py and test_desktop_put.py.
